title: Office
description: Desks, screens and a lot of coffee.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Hi, I'm new. Is this my desk?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, welcome! Your monitor and keyboard are already set up.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: In the corner, next to the water dispenser.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And where can I get some coffee?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Bring a mug. The kitchen is down the hall.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Let's tidy up before we leave.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'll put these files back in the filing cabinet.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Don't forget to water the plant.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And you should take your mug home this time.

selfTalk.text: The whiteboard is still covered with notes from yesterday's meeting.
Let me erase the whiteboard before the team comes in.
I hate it when the whiteboard markers run out of ink.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Can I wipe the whiteboard?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Wait, let me take a photo of it first.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Sure. Is that the project timeline?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, we spent an hour drawing it on the board.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Then I'll definitely wait.

selfTalk.text: Through the window, I can see the buildings across the street.
Let me open the window and get some fresh air.
I'm lucky my desk is so close to a window.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Mind if I open the window?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Go ahead. It's really stuffy in here.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is it too windy now?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it's perfect. Leave the window open.

selfTalk.text: The filing cabinet has three drawers, and the top one is locked.
I need to put these contracts in the filing cabinet.
I'm a little scared of what's in the bottom drawer of that filing cabinet.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Where do we keep the old invoices?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: In the filing cabinet, second drawer.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The cabinet is locked. Do you have the key?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ask Sam. He keeps it on his keychain.

selfTalk.text: There's a potted plant next to the filing cabinet.
I'll water the plant before I leave today.
That plant makes the office feel a lot less boring.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Who's been watering this plant?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I think it's Mia. She waters it every Friday.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It looks a lot healthier than the plant on my desk at home.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: She talks to it too, apparently.

selfTalk.text: My desk is covered in papers again.
Let me clear some space on my desk before the meeting.
I wish my desk were a little bigger.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is anyone sitting at this desk today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it's free. We don't have assigned desks anymore.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Great. Do I need to book it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Just write your name on the sheet by the door.

selfTalk.text: There's a smudge right in the middle of my monitor.
Let me tilt the monitor down a little. My neck hurts.
I'd love a second monitor for all these spreadsheets.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: My monitor just went black.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Did you check the cable at the back?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, it was loose. The screen is working now.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That happens to my monitor every Monday.

selfTalk.text: There's a yellow sticky note on the corner of my monitor.
I'll write the meeting time on a sticky note so I don't forget.
I have way too many sticky notes. I can't find the important ones.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What's this sticky note on my screen?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh, that's from me. Your client called while you were out.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Did they leave a number?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's on the back of the note.

selfTalk.text: A couple of keys on my keyboard are sticking.
I'm going to clean my keyboard. It's full of crumbs.
My keyboard is so loud. I hope it doesn't bother anyone.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is that your keyboard making all that noise?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yeah, sorry. It's a mechanical keyboard.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It sounds like rain on a roof.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Ha. I'll try to type more quietly.

selfTalk.text: My mouse is right next to the keyboard.
Let me charge my mouse during lunch.
This mouse is way too small for my hand.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: My cursor keeps freezing.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe your mouse needs new batteries.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good idea. Do we have any spare batteries for my mouse?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Check the supply cabinet by the printer.

selfTalk.text: My headset is lying next to my keyboard.
Let me put on my headset. The call starts in two minutes.
Wearing this headset all day makes my ears hurt.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Can you hear me okay?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're a bit quiet. Is your headset plugged in?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Oh, I was using the laptop mic. How about now?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Much better. The headset sounds great.

selfTalk.text: My mug still has some cold coffee in it.
Let me rinse my mug and make a fresh cup of tea.
I always leave my mug on my desk over the weekend.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is this your mug in the sink?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh, sorry. I'll wash it now.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: No worries. It's a cute mug.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thanks. My niece painted it for me.

selfTalk.text: There's a red stapler on the corner of my desk.
Let me staple these pages together before I forget.
This stapler keeps jamming. I should ask for a new one.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hey, do you have a stapler I could borrow?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure, it's in the top drawer.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Thanks! My stapler keeps jamming.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Just bring it back when you're done.

selfTalk.text: My swivel chair squeaks every time I lean back.
Let me raise my chair a little so I'm not hunching over.
Sometimes I spin around in my chair when I'm thinking.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Can I borrow your chair for the meeting?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure, just roll it back when you're done.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Will do. My chair has a broken wheel.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You should tell the office manager about that.

selfTalk.text: The water dispenser has both hot and cold water.
I'm going to refill my bottle at the water dispenser.
I should visit the water dispenser more often. I've only had one cup today.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is the water dispenser empty again?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yeah, the bottle needs changing.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Should I call someone?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, I can do it. It's heavy, though.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I'll help you lift it onto the dispenser.

selfTalk.text: The printer is in the corner, next to the water dispenser.
I need to print the report and pick it up from the printer.
The printer is out of paper again. Why does this always happen to me?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Is the printer working?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It says there's a paper jam.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Ugh. Do you know how to fix the printer?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Open the side panel and pull the paper out slowly.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Got it. Thanks!
